limitations: Tiny invented corpus with unusually explicit context; not real-meeting accuracy, security certification or model ranking
Wider prompts contain repeated neutral padding; not evidence of long-meeting context retention
Known alternatives were supplied; unknown error discovery and transcript rewriting were not tested
Only about 650 spoken-context words, not a full meeting or the advertised maximum context length
JSON was parsed and validated, not grammar-constrained during generation
Native Foundation baseline used a different prompt and is incomplete; no fair native/local superiority claim
MLX allocator setting is a guideline, not a hard cap; model-specific cache ignores max_kv_size
Process RSS and CPU omit some GPU/Metal compiler service costs; MLX peak is not whole-system memory
System swap is global; coincident growth cannot be exclusively attributed to inference
Five-second sampling allowed transient swap growth beyond the stop threshold
GPU load, thermal steady state, foreground responsiveness and battery impact were not measured
Weights and artifacts are in a temporary directory and may not survive automatic OS cleanup
